observations: Semantic A presses arrived but were rejected for no interaction target
Read-only inspection found native controller mode inactive, empty keyboard bindings and intact controller bindings on the offline Amazon
Owner confirmed opening and closing the tabbed menu restores interactions in the preceding build
Fresh candidate launch requests native controller layout at 16:59:05 PDT before opening UISwitcher
Targeted A interactions appear at 16:59:40, 17:00:04, 17:00:16 and 17:00:27 PDT without opening UISwitcher
Physical bow releases and native monster contacts continue in the same run
coverage: Recover controller targeting without sending an attack or changing saved bindings
Only fresh tracked motion gameplay can request a world layout transition
Missing player and open menu gates
Ownership expires after 300 ms without XR samples and clears immediately when inactive
World ownership cannot claim pointer dispatch or block walking
Returning from menus, tracking loss and level transitions permits recovery
headset_validation: Owner confirmed everything works after being asked to verify pickups, chests, shrines and cave entrances on the offline Amazon without opening the tabbed menu first.
scope: Windows SteamVR headset session; no new VDXR or Quest 2 headset check for this correction. Existing Windows VDXR support is retained.
